Thought: I need to determine what products are made from acetylene. Acetylene (C₂H₂) is an important industrial chemical used as a starting material for various syntheses.

Acetylene can be used to produce:
- Polyvinyl chloride (PVC)
- Acrylic acids and esters
- Vinyl acetate
- Various solvents
- Welding gases

Looking at the options:
A. Ethane (C₂H₆) - This is not typically made from acetylene
B. Methane (CH₄) - This is not typically made from acetylene
C. Polyethylene plastics - Polyethylene is typically made from ethylene, not acetylene
D. Propene (C₃H₆) - This is not typically made from acetylene

None of the options seem to be directly produced from acetylene. However, acetylene can be used in the production of various plastics. The closest option would be C, but polyethylene is specifically made from ethylene (C₂H₄), not acetylene (C₂H₂).

Let me double-check: Acetylene is used to make vinyl compounds and can be converted to ethylene, which is then used to make polyethylene. So indirectly, acetylene can be a precursor to polyethylene plastics.
